title.text: Sports & Live without cards — three views of the same games

n1.text: Timeline: games are blocks on a time axis, one row per league. The red line is now. Live blocks carry the score; the focused block opens the panel below. Left/Right moves through time, Up/Down through leagues.

n2.text: Scoreboard: big-type rows grouped Live / Starting soon / Final, like a stadium board. Finals are spoiler-hidden until you rest on them. The right side is the focused game: muted live preview, linescore, actions.

n3.text: Guide: channels as a classic TV guide — Now and Next per channel, with the live game pulled out of the channel's schedule when a score feed matches it.
